_comment: Interior behind `longhouse_door` (riverfarm_village) -- small communal hall, 10x7. FUNCTION: gives the village's one guest bed a real room (retires the open-lawn sleep-site read) and gives the headman's ledger a physical anchor. biome 'inn' reused (same wood-hall plank family as guild/inn_upstairs, not a new tileset). CONSTRAINT: south wall gapped at x=5 for `longhouse_exit`; arrival from the village lands one cell north of it (5,5), matching the guild_door/guild_exit offset convention. Hearth + 2 sconces = 3 lights total, well under the 8/map budget. TRAP: hearth/long-table/headman-table are added to `blocked` manually (decor never auto-blocks movement) -- stools/barrels/crate/sconces stay walkable, matching guild's own furniture-blocking split (counters/tables blocked, stools/rugs not).

floor_layers._pick: Same plank variant set as guild/inn_upstairs (Interior_Walls_01.png) -- every wood building in Liscor's orbit reads as the same hall material.

segments._comment: South wall, gapped at x=5 for longhouse_exit.

_comment_ambience: Same dusk/night dust-motes pattern as every other wood interior (guild/inn_upstairs precedent).

entities._comment: Return door -- to_cell (11,8) is the SAME open cell the player stood on outside to approach longhouse_door in the first place (the guild_exit/guild_door offset convention).

The village's sleep site, relocated off the open lawn into a real room. Mechanically identical to every other sleep prop (sleep: true, checked first in interact()'s prop match) -- sleep_toast text held verbatim across the move. Placed against the east wall (col 9), footprint clear of the approach column (col 8, rows 3/5 open on both sides).
entities.observe: A straw-tick pallet against the wall, blanket already turned down for whoever needs it.
entities.sleep_toast: Straw tick, borrowed blanket — Riverfarm always finds room for one more.

entities._comment: Flavor-only (on_interact_accomplishment + toast, same shape as guild_notice_wall) -- the headman's own ledger, left on his corner table. No gate, no quest tie.
entities.observe: A ledger left open on the corner table, the same one he carries everywhere else. Columns re-summed in three different inks -- he never trusts the first count, or the second.
entities.toast: Grain against debts, and the debts keep winning most years. Best not to read it over his shoulder.
